text: Hey Salim, good to see you! Come on in.
Hey Sebastian. Thanks for having me over today.
Anytime, man. Just brewed some coffee if you want a cup.
I'd really appreciate that, black is fine.
Coming right up. Grab a seat wherever, make yourself comfortable.
Thanks, my deadline yesterday completely drained the life out of me.
Random question, but do you know anything about frogs around here?
Shame. Back home after the rain, they'd be everywhere.
It feels weirdly warm out today, despite all the wind.
Yeah, sticky weather. Hopefully it just breaks into rain soon.
A downpour would definitely match my mood a lot better.
Back in Pelican Town, wind like this meant a storm.
A good storm sounds nice, maybe it'd clear my head.
Rain on the valley roof beat any sound in the city.
That last lightning strike sounded way too close to the building.
Hey, do you have any more on you today?
Always got some for you, but it'll cost a little extra charm.
